name: cru_goo_blue2
desc: Add only thick glossy HOT PINK paint goo with yellow marble streaks and dark outline (pink, not blue). Thick sticky pink goo bands grow out of the blue monster's chest and wrap around the small cat's wrists and ankles, gluing the cat flat onto the chest. Some pink goo is smeared over the cat's cape and belly and drips down. Do not change the cat itself (same face, eyes, hat, cape, pose, size, position) and do not change the blue monster at all.
